scope: All 1277 retained native cases; all 15 declared axes. Every listed input value occurs in a native case with the listed violated predicate. These associations do not establish causal attribution, monotonicity or feasibility boundaries. Ranges are observed extrema, not continuous intervals of failure.
case_id_convention: case_ids are exact exported case labels in results/cases.json; its candidate_id field gives the native store ID.
method: For each declared axis and each actually violated predicate, select all retained native cases whose verdict is violated and summarize each axis input over that subset. Distinct values are enumerated when count <=20; otherwise preserve observed extrema and their case IDs. Coupled input keys stay separate, with exact combinations recoverable through case_ids.
